CustomField.description: Instalment sales at Payment Arranged: orange while Finance sets up the plan and the deposit is awaited, green when the plan is signed off by the Head of Finance and the deposit is received (US-29), so the rep can close the sale.
CustomField.formula: IF(AND(ISPICKVAL(Payment_Mode__c, "Instalment"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Payment Arranged")), IF(AND(Signed_Off_Plans__c > 0, Down_Payment_Received__c > 0), "🟢 Ready to close: plan signed off and deposit received", IF(Signed_Off_Plans__c > 0, "🟠 With Finance: plan signed off, waiting for the deposit", IF(Down_Payment_Received__c > 0, "🟠 With Finance: deposit received, waiting for plan sign-off", "🟠 With Finance: payment plan being set up"))), NULL)
CustomField.label: AM Finance Status
